chunks: If it is during the Dhuhr salat (prayer), he should make the first two rak'ahs obligatory and the last two rak'ahs voluntary. If it is during the Asr salat (prayer), he should make the first two rak'ahs voluntary and the last two rak'ahs obligatory.

key_terms.صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ: the Dhuhr salat (prayer), the noon obligatory prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ: the Asr salat (prayer), the afternoon obligatory prayer
key_terms.فَرِيضَةً: obligatory as part of the required prayer

ai.seo_question: How are the rak'ahs counted as obligatory or voluntary between Dhuhr and Asr salat (prayer) in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning how rak'ahs are to be counted between Dhuhr and Asr salat (prayer) in a particular prayer scenario. It distinguishes which two rak'ahs are treated as obligatory and which are treated as voluntary in each of the two prayers.
